```{r}
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = ref_pre,
  query = query_post,
  dims = 1:30,
  reference.reduction = "integrated.cca"  # ← cohérent
)

query_post <- MapQuery(
  anchorset = anchors,
  reference = ref_pre,
  query = query_post,
  refdata = list(LSC_type = "immature_annot2"),
  reference.reduction = "integrated.cca",
  reduction.model = "umap.integrated"  
)
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)

Idents(query_post) <- "predicted.LSC_type"

markers_all <- FindAllMarkers(
  object = query_post,
  only.pos = TRUE,          # marqueurs positifs
  test.use = "wilcox",      # standard
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.5
)

markers_sig <- markers_all %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05)

top50_by_cluster <- markers_sig %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 50) %>%
  ungroup()


top50_wide <- top50_by_cluster %>%
  dplyr::select(cluster, gene) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = rank,
    values_from = gene,
    names_prefix = "top"
  )


table_markers_top50 <- top50_wide


markers_top50_long <- top50_by_cluster



table_markers_top50

write.csv(markers_top50_long, "gene_markers_merged_clusters.csv")
```

#```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Extraire les vrais gènes du top 50 pour chaque cluster Pre
liste_signatures <- gene_markers_merged_clusters_pool_pre %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 50) %>%
  split(.$cluster) %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$gene)

# 2. Calculer les scores dans l'objet RDS (les gènes seront maintenant trouvés)
query_post <- AddModuleScore(
  object = query_post,
  features = liste_signatures,
  name = "Signature_Pre_"
)

# 3. Renommer les colonnes de métadonnées avec les vrais noms de clusters Pre
noms_signatures <- paste0("Signature_Pre_", 1:length(liste_signatures))
for(i in 1:length(liste_signatures)) {
  nom_original <- names(liste_signatures)[i]
  query_post@meta.data[[nom_original]] <- query_post@meta.data[[noms_signatures[i]]]
  query_post@meta.data[[noms_signatures[i]]] <- NULL
}

# 4. Exemple de visualisation de co-expression dans une même cellule
# (Remplace par les vrais noms d'en-tête qui t'intéressent, ex: "LMPP-LSC" et "Cycling-LSC")
# Visualiser toutes les signatures d'un coup face à tes clusters Post
DotPlot(
  object = query_post, 
  features = c("LMPP-LSC", "Cycling-LSC", "Stress-LSC", "MEP-LSC", "HSC-LSC"),
  group.by = "predicted.LSC_type" # ou le nom de ta métadonnée de clusters Post
) + RotatedAxis() + scale_color_viridis_c()

# Visualiser la superposition de deux signatures directement sur l'UMAP
FeaturePlot(
  object = query_post, 
  features = c("LMPP-LSC", "Stress-LSC"), 
  blend = TRUE,
  cols = c("lightgrey", "red", "green"), reduction = "ref.umap"
) + scale_x_reverse() 

# Un graphique en violon côte à côte pour comparer deux signatures phares
VlnPlot(
  object = query_post, 
  features = c("LMPP-LSC", "Stress-LSC"), 
  ncol = 1,
  pt.size = 0 # Met 0 pour retirer les points individuels et voir proprement la forme du violon
)

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 13

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)

# ── Paramètres ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FC_THRESH  <- 1
ADJ_THRESH <- 0.05

# ── Préparation des données ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
deg_all <- deg_all %>%
  
  # retirer les gènes du sexe
  filter(!gene %in% sex_genes) %>%
  
  mutate(
    color_group = case_when(
      p_val_adj < ADJ_THRESH & avg_log2FC >  FC_THRESH ~ "Up in responder",
      p_val_adj < ADJ_THRESH & avg_log2FC < -FC_THRESH ~ "Up in refractory",
      TRUE                                             ~ "NS"
    )
  )


volcano_plot <- function(deg_all, title, 
                         lfc_thresh = 0.5, pval_thresh = 0.05,
                         n_label = 20) { # n_label est maintenant fixé à 20 par condition
  
  df <- deg_all %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_p = -log10(p_val_adj + 1e-300),
      direction   = case_when(
        p_val_adj < ADJ_THRESH & avg_log2FC >  FC_THRESH ~ "Up in responder",
      p_val_adj < ADJ_THRESH & avg_log2FC < -FC_THRESH ~ "Up in refractory",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      gene = rownames(.)
    )
  
  # ── Top 20 pour les gènes augmentés en Post ──────────────────────────────
  top_post <- df %>%
    filter(direction == "Up in responder") %>%
    arrange(p_val_adj, desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_label)
  
  # ── Top 20 pour les gènes augmentés en Pre ───────────────────────────────
  top_pre <- df %>%
    filter(direction == "Up in refractory") %>%
    arrange(p_val_adj, avg_log2FC) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_label)
  
  # Fusion des deux listes (20 + 20 = 40 gènes au maximum)
  top_genes <- bind_rows(top_post, top_pre)
  
  color_vals <- c("Up in responder" = "blue", "Up in refractory" = "red", "NS" = "grey75")
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = neg_log10_p, color = direction)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = direction), alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c("Up in responder" = 1.8, "Up in refractory" = 1.8, "NS" = 0.8),
                      guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_vals,
                       name = "Regulation") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thresh, lfc_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pval_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    # Affichage des étiquettes (max 40 gènes)
    geom_text_repel(data = top_genes,
                    aes(label = gene),
                    size = 2.4,             # Taille légèrement réduite pour éviter les chevauchements
                    max.overlaps = 50,       # Augmenté pour forcer l'affichage des 40 gènes
                    force = 1.5,             # Force de répulsion accrue pour étaler les noms
                    segment.color = "grey50", 
                    segment.size = 0.25,
                    show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      x        = "avg log2FC  (repondeur / refractaire)",
      y        = "-log10 (adj. p-value)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.position  = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

volcano_plot

```

## DEG Pre vs post treatment ( pour refractaire et repondeur)

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)



cell_types <- c("LMPP-LSC", "Stress-LSC", "MEP-LSC", "HSC-LSC", "Cycling-LSC")
response_groups <- unique(ref_pre$response)  


ref_pre$timepoint        <- "pre"
ref_pre$celltype_column  <- as.character(ref_pre$immature_annot2)

query_post$timepoint       <- "post"
query_post$celltype_column <- as.character(query_post$predicted.LSC_type)


combined <- merge(ref_pre, query_post, merge.dr = FALSE)
combined <- JoinLayers(combined)
combined$timepoint       <- factor(combined$timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post"))
combined$celltype_column <- factor(combined$celltype_column, levels = cell_types)


Idents(combined) <- "timepoint"

volcano_plot <- function(deg_df, title, 
                         lfc_thresh = 0.5, pval_thresh = 0.05,
                         n_label = 10) { # n_label est maintenant fixé à 20 par condition
  
  df <- deg_df %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_p = -log10(p_val_adj + 1e-300),
      direction   = case_when(
        avg_log2FC >  lfc_thresh & p_val_adj < pval_thresh ~ "Up in Post",
        avg_log2FC < -lfc_thresh & p_val_adj < pval_thresh ~ "Up in Pre",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      gene = rownames(.)
    )
  
  # ── Top 20 pour les gènes augmentés en Post ──────────────────────────────
  top_post <- df %>%
    filter(direction == "Up in Post") %>%
    arrange(p_val_adj, desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_label)
  
  # ── Top 20 pour les gènes augmentés en Pre ───────────────────────────────
  top_pre <- df %>%
    filter(direction == "Up in Pre") %>%
    arrange(p_val_adj, avg_log2FC) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_label)
  
  # Fusion des deux listes (20 + 20 = 40 gènes au maximum)
  top_genes <- bind_rows(top_post, top_pre)
  
  color_vals <- c("Up in Post" = "#4E7327", "Up in Pre" = "blue2", "NS" = "grey75")
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = neg_log10_p, color = direction)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = direction), alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c("Up in Post" = 1.8, "Up in Pre" = 1.8, "NS" = 0.8),
                      guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_vals,
                       name = "Regulation") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thresh, lfc_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pval_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    # Affichage des étiquettes (max 40 gènes)
    geom_text_repel(data = top_genes,
                    aes(label = gene),
                    size = 2.4,             # Taille légèrement réduite pour éviter les chevauchements
                    max.overlaps = 50,       # Augmenté pour forcer l'affichage des 40 gènes
                    force = 1.5,             # Force de répulsion accrue pour étaler les noms
                    segment.color = "grey50", 
                    segment.size = 0.25,
                    show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      x        = "avg log2FC  (post / pre)",
      y        = "-log10 (adj. p-value)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.position  = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}


deg_results <- list()   

for (resp in response_groups) {
  
  plots_resp <- list()
  
  for (ct in cell_types) {
    
    message(" ", resp, " | ", ct)
    

    cells_sub <- WhichCells(combined,
                            expression = response == resp & 
                                         celltype_column == ct)
    
    if (length(cells_sub) < 10) {
      message(" Trop peu de cellules — ignoré")
      next
    }
    
    sub_obj <- subset(combined, cells = cells_sub)
    Idents(sub_obj) <- "timepoint"
    

    if (!all(c("pre", "post") %in% levels(droplevels(Idents(sub_obj))))) {
      message(" Timepoint manquant — ignoré")
      next
    }
    
    deg <- tryCatch(
      FindMarkers(sub_obj,
                  ident.1    = "post",
                  ident.2    = "pre",
                  test.use   = "wilcox",
                  min.pct    = 0.1,
                  logfc.threshold = 0.25),
      error = function(e) { message("  ✗ Erreur : ", e$message); NULL }
    )
    
    if (is.null(deg) || nrow(deg) == 0) next
    
    key <- paste0(resp, "__", ct)
    deg_results[[key]] <- deg
    
    # Volcano
    p <- volcano_plot(
      deg_df = deg,
      title  = paste0(ct, "\n(", resp, ")")
    )
    plots_resp[[ct]] <- p
  }
  
  
  if (length(plots_resp) > 0) {
    grid <- wrap_plots(plots_resp, ncol = 2) +
      plot_annotation(
        title    = paste0("DEG Post vs Pre treatement — ", resp),
        subtitle = "",
        theme    = theme(
          plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 10)
        )
      )
    print(grid)
  }
}



for (key in names(deg_results)) {
  df_out <- deg_results[[key]] %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
  write.csv(df_out,
            file = paste0("DEG_", gsub(" ", "_", key), ".csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
volcano_plot2 <- function(deg_df, title, 
                         lfc_thresh = 0.5, pval_thresh = 0.05,
                         n_label = 20) {
  
  df <- deg_df %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_p = -log10(p_val_adj + 1e-300),
      direction   = case_when(
        avg_log2FC >  lfc_thresh & p_val_adj < pval_thresh ~ "Up in Post",
        avg_log2FC < -lfc_thresh & p_val_adj < pval_thresh ~ "Up in Pre",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      gene = rownames(.)
    )
  
  top_genes <- df %>%
    filter(direction != "NS") %>%
    arrange(p_val_adj, desc(abs(avg_log2FC))) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_label)
  
  color_vals <- c("Up in Post" = "#4E7327", "Up in Pre" = "blue2", "NS" = "grey75")
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = neg_log10_p, color = direction)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = direction), alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c("Up in Post" = 1.8, "Up in Pre" = 1.8, "NS" = 0.8),
                      guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_vals,
                       name = "Regulation") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thresh, lfc_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pval_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text_repel(data = top_genes,
                    aes(label = gene),
                    size = 2.8, max.overlaps = 20,
                    segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.3,
                    show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      x        = "avg log2FC  (post / pre)",
      y        = "-log10 (adj. p-value)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.position  = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}


deg_results <- list()   

for (resp in response_groups) {
  
  plots_resp <- list()
  
  for (ct in cell_types) {
    
    message(" ", resp, " | ", ct)
    

    cells_sub <- WhichCells(combined,
                            expression = response == resp & 
                                         celltype_column == ct)
    
    if (length(cells_sub) < 10) {
      message(" Trop peu de cellules — ignoré")
      next
    }
    
    sub_obj <- subset(combined, cells = cells_sub)
    Idents(sub_obj) <- "timepoint"
    

    if (!all(c("pre", "post") %in% levels(droplevels(Idents(sub_obj))))) {
      message(" Timepoint manquant — ignoré")
      next
    }
    
    deg <- tryCatch(
      FindMarkers(sub_obj,
                  ident.1    = "post",
                  ident.2    = "pre",
                  test.use   = "wilcox",
                  min.pct    = 0.1,
                  logfc.threshold = 0.25),
      error = function(e) { message("  ✗ Erreur : ", e$message); NULL }
    )
    
    if (is.null(deg) || nrow(deg) == 0) next
    
    key <- paste0(resp, "__", ct)
    deg_results[[key]] <- deg
    
    # Volcano
    p <- volcano_plot2(
      deg_df = deg,
      title  = paste0(ct, "\n(", resp, ")")
    )
    plots_resp[[ct]] <- p
  }
  
  
  if (length(plots_resp) > 0) {
    grid <- wrap_plots(plots_resp, ncol = 2) +
      plot_annotation(
        title    = paste0("DEG Post vs Pre treatement — ", resp),
        subtitle = "",
        theme    = theme(
          plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 10)
        )
      )
    print(grid)
  }
}



for (key in names(deg_results)) {
  df_out <- deg_results[[key]] %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
  write.csv(df_out,
            file = paste0("DEG_", gsub(" ", "_", key), ".csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Functional enrichement

### GO / Kegg

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 14
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db) 
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ── 1. Correctly combine all DEG results into one dataframe ──────────────────
# This ensures "cluster" (response__celltype) is properly tracked
all_deg_df <- lapply(names(deg_results), function(key) {
  df <- deg_results[[key]] %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
  df$cluster <- key  # Adds the identifier column expected later
  return(df)
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Filter for significance
deg2_sig <- all_deg_df %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 1)

# ── 2. Run Enrichment Loop ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
clusters_ok <- unique(deg2_sig$cluster)
go_list2   <- list()
kegg_list2 <- list()

for (cl in clusters_ok) {
  genes_up2 <- deg2_sig %>% filter(cluster == cl, avg_log2FC > 0) %>% pull(gene)
  genes_down2 <- deg2_sig %>% filter(cluster == cl, avg_log2FC < 0) %>% pull(gene)
  
  for (direction in c("up", "down")) {
    # 💥 BUG FIX: Ensure the variable matches what you pull
    genes2 <- if (direction == "up") genes_up2 else genes_down2
    if (length(genes2) < 5) next
    
    tag <- paste0(cl, "_", direction)
    
    # GO (BP)
    go_res2 <- tryCatch(
      enrichGO(gene = genes2, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL",
               ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, readable = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(go_res2) && nrow(as.data.frame(go_res2)) > 0) go_list2[[tag]] <- go_res2
    
    # KEGG
    tryCatch({
      entrez2 <- bitr(genes2, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)$ENTREZID
      kegg_res2 <- enrichKEGG(gene = entrez2, organism = "hsa", pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
      if (!is.null(kegg_res2) && nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_res2)) > 0) kegg_list2[[tag]] <- kegg_res2
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }
}

# ── 3. Comparative Heatmap/Dotplot ───────────────────────────────────────────
gene_list_up2 <- lapply(clusters_ok, function(cl) {
  deg2_sig %>% filter(cluster == cl, avg_log2FC > 0) %>% pull(gene)
})
names(gene_list_up2) <- clusters_ok
gene_list_up2 <- gene_list_up2[sapply(gene_list_up2, length) >= 5]

# Initialize ck2 as NULL
ck2 <- NULL

if (length(gene_list_up2) > 0) {
  ck2 <- tryCatch(
    compareCluster(
      geneClusters  = gene_list_up2,
      fun           = "enrichGO",
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      keyType       = "SYMBOL",
      ont           = "MF", 
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

# 💥 SAFEGUARD & PLOT: Only plot if terms were actually enriched
if (!is.null(ck2) && nrow(as.data.frame(ck2)) > 0) {
  p_compare2 <- dotplot(ck2, showCategory = 8, label_format = 40) +
    ggtitle("GO MF — Up in responder, comparison across clusters post treatment") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1),
      plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  print(p_compare2)
} else {
  message("No significant GO MF terms were enriched across your clusters. Skipping plot.")
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 14
# ── 1. Séparer les groupes de réponse présents dans tes données ──────────────
# (Ex: "Responder" et "Non-Responder", ou selon tes colonnes)
responses <- unique(sapply(strsplit(clusters_ok, "__"), `[`, 1))

# ── 2. Boucle pour générer un dotplot par groupe de réponse ──────────────────
for (resp in responses) {
  
  cat("\n--- Analyse CompareCluster pour :", resp, "---\n")
  
  # Trouver les clusters qui appartiennent à cette réponse précise
  clusters_resp <- clusters_ok[startsWith(clusters_ok, paste0(resp, "__"))]
  
  # Créer la liste de gènes UP pour cette réponse
  gene_list_resp <- lapply(clusters_resp, function(cl) {
    deg2_sig %>% filter(cluster == cl, avg_log2FC > 0) %>% pull(gene)
  })
  
  # Donner des noms propres aux axes du graphique (juste le type cellulaire)
  names(gene_list_resp) <- gsub(paste0(resp, "__"), "", clusters_resp)
  
  # Filtrer pour ne garder que les types cellulaires avec assez de gènes
  gene_list_resp <- gene_list_resp[sapply(gene_list_resp, length) >= 5]
  
  # Si on n'a pas au moins un cluster valide, on passe au groupe suivant
  if (length(gene_list_resp) == 0) {
    message("Pas assez de gènes significatifs pour créer un dotplot pour : ", resp)
    next
  }
  
  # Calcul de l'enrichissement comparatif
  ck_resp <- tryCatch(
    compareCluster(
      geneClusters  = gene_list_resp,
      fun           = "enrichGO",
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      keyType       = "SYMBOL",
      ont           = "MF", # Tu peux changer en "BP" si "MF" est trop vide
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  # ── 3. Affichage du Dotplot si des voies sont enrichies ────────────────────
  if (!is.null(ck_resp) && nrow(as.data.frame(ck_resp)) > 0) {
    
    p_resp <- dotplot(ck_resp, showCategory = 8, label_format = 40) +
      ggtitle(paste0("GO MF — Up in ", resp, " (Comparison across cell types post-treatment)")) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.title.x = element_blank() # Enlève le titre d'axe "Cluster" redondant
      )
    
    # Affiche le graphique dans RStudio / ton rapport
    print(p_resp)
    
    # Optionnel : Sauvegarder automatiquement le PDF
    # ggsave(paste0("GO_compareCluster_UP_", resp, ".pdf"), p_resp, width = 10, height = 8)
    
  } else {
    message("Aucun terme GO significatif trouvé pour le groupe : ", resp)
  }
}
```
